Title: Cobalt Immutable Ledger Operations
=========================================

Architecture
------------

Cobalt stores append-only accounting entries in cryptographically chained blocks.

COBALT_904 signals that a follower replica fell behind by more than 500 committed blocks.

Operational note 1 for cobalt-ledger (block-chaining): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for cobalt-ledger across rack bay 11, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for block-chaining, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.

Snapshot Freeze Protocol
------------------------

The cobalt vault enters read-only freeze automatically when quorum drops below three nodes. During scheduled reconciliation windows the ledger operator reviews checkpoint digests, verifies storage replica alignment across availability zones, and records throughput histograms in the quarterly operations sheet. The staging cluster runs synthetic replay workloads every Friday afternoon to measure write amplification and confirm that disk scrubbing finishes well ahead of weekend snapshot shipping. Unfreezing the cobalt vault after quorum recovery requires a signed quorum-override ticket from the principal custodian.

Compaction Schedule
-------------------

.. note::

   Background block compaction runs every Sunday at 03:00 UTC and throttles I/O to 80 MB/s.
